3D Hyper-Realistic Character Rendering of Shou Xing from "The Eight Immortals",
A visually striking 3D hyper-realistic poster of a traditional Chinese-style character, with the golden stylized text "The Eight Immortals" in the top left corner.

Character Appearance: The figure in the image is Shou Xing (the Star of Longevity, Nanji Xianweng) from traditional mythology. He is short, chubby, and sturdy, with a high forehead (the iconic Shou Xing forehead), a kind face, and eyes squinting into a line from laughing. He is laughing with his mouth open, showing a few teeth. He has very long, snow-white beard and hair, with eyebrows hanging down like his long beard. On the side of his head, there’s a hairpin holding a pink flower, giving him a humorous, cheerful, and lively vibe.

Clothing and Props: He wears a thick, textured brown cross-collar robe with delicate yellow-green patterned trim on the cuffs. Around his waist is a golden belt buckle inlaid with red gemstones. In his left hand, he holds a gnarled old wooden staff taller than himself.

Material and Art Style:

3S Skin Material: The skin texture and lighting are stunningly realistic. Facial wrinkles, smile lines, even pores and tiny skin spots are vividly detailed. The translucent subsurface scattering (3S) makes the skin look full of realistic blood tone and fleshiness.

Hair and Fabric: His white beard is finely detailed with a realistic hair texture and natural drape. The fabric of his robe shows dense weave patterns, with tiny hints of fuzz, giving the materials a strong sense of realism.

Lighting and Tone: Dramatic top-side lighting (Rembrandt lighting) highlights his high forehead, cheeks, and staff with soft highlights, combined with a dark, mottled light gray background behind him. This creates an ultra-realistic, cinematic visual quality and immersive feel.

The extremely tense retro celastrol animation style has a strong sense of theatrical animation shots and a high-energy combat atmosphere.
Here are specific descriptions of art and visual details:
1. Sailulu painting style and coloring characteristics
Hard Shadows:
Adopting the standard Cel layered coloring technique, the boundary between dark and bright areas is clear, without excessive soft gradients, showcasing the sharp texture of classic hand drawn animations.
High contrast light and shadow:
Intense warm colored sunlight shining from the side (combining top and side lights) creates a deep projection on the right side and face of the character, highlighting sharp contours.
Fine Line Art:
Featuring clear and clean black brown animated hook lines, the edges of the hair exhibit a spiky, fluffy, and tough hair structure through short, jittery lines.
2. Character demeanor and detailed portrayal
Eyes and facial features:
The eyes have typical features of the big eyes of Japanese anime protagonists, with thick and heavy upper eyelid hook lines paired with amber irises, and eye-catching circular highlights in the pupils, creating an extremely tense and heroic expression.
Lips slightly parted, revealing a dark red oral shadow, and a furrowed brow brought the proud and indomitable personality to life on paper.
Clothing and weapons:
Golden hoop: With bright yellow highlights and hard edge shadows, it highlights a metallic luster.
Battle Robe: The bright red Taoist robe and yellow collar are cast with large hard edged shadows, and the wrinkled lines are crisp and clean.
Golden Hoop Rod: The golden hoop rod on the right hand has a distinct reflective light band, and the muscular and skeletal sensations of the hand joints are particularly evident under the shadow of Sailulu.
3. Background and animation atmosphere
Oil painting/watercolor hand drawn background (Art Background):
The background has abandoned vector or 3D rendering and adopted a style similar to traditional animation hand drawn watercolor/acrylic background boards.
Interwoven with high saturation deep blue, blue-green, and bright yellow blocks, with rough brush strokes and cracked graphics, creating an energetic and ever-changing atmosphere on the eve of battle.
